description: Generate presentations, documents, websites, and social posts programmatically.

novel_features.name: Async Generation Watcher
novel_features.description: Polls GET /v1.0/generations/{id} every 5s until status is completed or failed, showing a spinner on TTY and NDJSON events for piped output. Bridges the async gap so users don't have to manually poll get-status.

novel_features.name: Export Auto-Downloader
novel_features.description: After --watch completes, downloads the exportUrl to a local directory with the gammaId as filename. Eliminates the manual curl step after generation.

novel_features.name: Sharing Preset Shorthand
novel_features.description: Maps convenient preset names (private, view-link, edit-link, workspace-view) to the workspaceAccess + externalAccess flag pair, replacing 2 flags with 1.

novel_features.name: Image Source Shorthand
novel_features.description: Short alias for --image-options-source that sets the AI model for image generation without the nested flag path.
